usage: The word '水費' (seoi2 fai3) is used to refer to the water bill amount that one needs to pay.
'水費' is typically used as a noun and often appears after words like '交' (to pay) or '收' (to collect).
You can say '交水費' to mean 'pay the water bill'.
It can be used in both formal and informal contexts when discussing utility payments.
When talking about bills, '水費' is commonly grouped with other utility bills such as electricity or gas bills.
